python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df[(df[0] == 'EXPENSES').cummax() & df[0].notna() & df[1].notna() & df[2].notna()]
exp = exp[~exp[0].isin(['EXPENSES', 'Total Expenses'])]
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print('Total:', exp['Amount'].sum())

# Confirm formula intact (not overwritten with hardcoded value)
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
print('C23 formula:', repr(wb['Budget']['C23'].value))
"
